facts.claim: A total of 1,597 miles of road along with 309 bridges and 1,998 drains were built in the Province before the Public Works Department was organized.
facts.quote: Altogether 1,597 miles of road, with 309 bridges, and 1,998 drains were constructed in the Province after the transfer of Government and before a regular Department of Public Works was organized.

facts.claim: Electric telegraph lines were started in 1853, which included a line from Attibele to Rampur measuring 191 miles.
facts.quote: Among the miscellaneous works executed was the commencement in 1853, and in great part completion, of flying and permanent electric telegraph lines, — one from Attibele near Oossoor to Rampur on the Bellary frontier, being a length of 191 miles
